description: Sets the memberships that unlock some cards' rates, such as amazon-prime for Prime Visa's 5% or a Bank of America Preferred Rewards tier, and costco for a Costco membership (so spending answers don't count its cost against Costco Anywhere). Replaces the whole list, so include the ones to keep. It saves them even with no cards saved, and every answer then uses them. It uses the wallet file on this computer, not the hosted earnrate connector's wallet.
